benchmark: QAngaroo WikiHop v1.1 official dev split
support_metric_limitation: Official WikiHop dev annotations expose relation patterns, not gold supporting source sentence indices.
control: MiniLM sentence-atom rank with candidate-aware verifier and reader
treatment: Phase34 answer-guided semantic selector with canonical citation IDs and candidate-aware reader
hypothesis: Canonicalizing valid numeric citation IDs removes a mechanical fallback bottleneck and reveals whether answer-guided semantic selection improves EM.
canonicalization: JSON citation_ids integer k or digit string k maps to S{k:02d} only before the existing whitelist, distinct-source, and token-cap checks; out-of-range IDs remain invalid.
